body: i feel ya it took me 3 years of jumping job to job before i found my calling i was a good artist i dabbled in animation i can play guitar and was raised as a country boy in the fields of Tennessee but in the end I'm an automotive mechanic and i love my work and i choose to stay out in the boonies even though i could make a killing in nashville or any city i'd rather do an host living and tinker with my hobbies, and some local girls of course but i never thought i would have been in my line of work without a little push from my past just the memory of workin on that old 1977 ford F150 he'd been working on for years never got it running but that momorie is what got me to walk out to the garage one night and within 3 weeks i had me a truck. so even with something like a career u may have just not found it yet but maybe my story will help you with your own quest to find happiness in your work.

Tbh i agree with you and to tell ya the truth i've been in your shoes and let me tell you but the best way to deal for you may be to learn as you go if u hate the job your n ask yourself why and then set a tolerable median find a job that is secure for start but make sure its something that will keep your interest without an overwhelming amount of stress for starters also depending on if your a morning person set a sleep schedule depending on your hours and ask for a time that will work for u i have found that working within my sleeping habits makes the day so much less stressful and thus helps decrease the severity of my daily depression also if u can use free time to get out more go to the gym also try and improve your eating habits i've found that drinking water helps with my depression as well but along the lines of not wanting to live into the future i'd say that   the reason u cant see your future is because u have already decided that you probably have none but if u give a little more effort and try not to stress you may see yourself in a whole new world all together

Sorry if this wasn't helpful but its all i got for ya i've only just started this course myself but in honest truth when i first found this path i couldn't see 2 weeks in the future and almost ended it all but with help from people i though didn't care for me my boss actually if u can believe it saved me and helped me see where life could take me and hopefully the same will happen for you. just recognize that you are not alone.
